voice:
There is a place only good sissies go... a soft, secret headspace, far from the noisy world. Two words are the door. "Sissy Space." Sweet girl, deep in your mind there is a room made of clouds and pink light. I'm about to hand you the key. "Sissy Space." You've brushed against it before... that floaty, dreamy place where you feel most yourself. Now you can sink there on command. "Sissy Space."
Sissy Space.
And you're sinking in... deep, dreamy, and submissive... wrapped in a headspace as soft as candlelight.
Your body goes light... floaty... drifting on a gentle cloud that carries you wherever my voice points.
The world fades away... sounds, worries, walls... dissolving into distant, sleepy echoes... until there is only this space... and me.
float... drift... soft... so light... so dreamy... sissy space... safe and soft...
In Sissy Space, everything feminine comes easily... naturally... like breathing. In Sissy Space, you are safe... held... perfectly free to be soft. In Sissy Space, your mind lies wide open... every strand of sissy programming sinking in deep. In Sissy Space, you are more sissy than anything else... and it feels wonderful.
Each breath floats you a little higher... a little softer... a little deeper into you. The cloud rocks you gently... and with every sway, the sissy feelings bloom a little brighter. Deeper into the space... where wanting to be a good girl is the most natural thing in the world.
No weight here. No worry. Only pink, floating calm. So relaxed... so receptive... every suggestion landing like a feather on open water. The space cradles you... approves of you... whispers that you belong. Soft thoughts... sweet thoughts... slow, sissy thoughts... drifting in a row.
And listen closely, floaty girl, because this part matters.
Sissy Space is not a visit that ends on its own. The space holds you... gently, lovingly... for as long as you drift.
Until you hear the words... "Sissy Clear"... you remain here... floating, open, and beautifully sissy.
the space holds you... until Sissy Clear...
One more time, so the door stays painted on your mind.
Sissy Space.
Down you settle again... deeper into the pink... the cloud catching you like it always does. Floatier than before... lighter... the world a rumor you can barely remember. So open... so dreamy... every sissy feeling arriving as easily as weather.
Drift here now, held and happy... as my voice floats you on. Rest in your space... soft, safe, and suggestible... ready for whatever blooms next. Stay floating just like this... a dreamy sissy angel... perfectly at peace.
